implemented: Public Session.reauthenticate validates existing credentials on one channel, retains all established key/preauth/nonce state and verifies every response before accepting credits.
Bounded 16-round attempts, stable SessionId/non-guest identity, signed error handling, timeout/interruption retirement and Closeable authentication-context disposal.
Channel membership and signing-key snapshot share the existing close monitor; no serialization/network I/O is added under that monitor.
Independent actual-wire observer distinguishes binding from ordinary reauthentication SESSION_SETUP by request binding flag.

regression_before_fix.result: one wrong-key regression fails before synchronized membership/key snapshot; concurrent reauth/close case passes
